input.quote: unless terminated by either Party hereto upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other.
input.rationale: Section 4.1 gives the Company only a 90-day convenience right (and gives HDI a symmetrical right that, on its face, is not confined to the end of a term), while Section 4.2 imposes an uncapped, formula-based Termination Payment on the Company alone equal to 50% of the preceding twelve months' Net Sales above $800,000 — a penalty that can far exceed the 30% revenue-share fees actually payable under Section 3.1 and well above the playbook's 3-months'-fees fallback cap. Playbook position: Customer may exit for convenience on 30 days' notice without penalty and with a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees, and Vendor has no mid-term convenience right. The redline adds the 30-day Company right with refund, restricts HDI's convenience termination to the end of the then-current term on 90 days' notice, and removes the Termination Payment; the 3-month fee cap fallback is offered in the comment.

proposal.summary: Give the Company a 30-day convenience termination right with pro-rata refund, limit HDI's convenience right to the end of a term, and remove the Net Sales-based Termination Payment.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have added a Company right to terminate for convenience on thirty (30) days' notice with a refund of prepaid fees, limited HDI's convenience right to the end of the then-current term on ninety (90) days' notice, and deleted the Section 4.2 Termination Payment, which is an uncapped penalty (50% of Net Sales over $800,000) far exceeding the fees we pay. If HDI needs some exit compensation, we can accept an early-termination fee capped at three (3) months' fees in lieu of the Section 4.2 formula.

ops.oldText: unless terminated by either Party hereto upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other. Such notice shall specify the date on which this Agreement is to be terminated (the "Termination Date").
ops.newText: unless terminated in accordance with this Section 4.1. The Company may terminate this Agreement for convenience, in whole or in part, at any time upon thirty (30) days prior written notice to HDI, in which case HDI shall refund any prepaid fees for the period after the effective date of termination. HDI may terminate this Agreement for convenience only effective as of the end of the then-current term, upon ninety (90) days prior written notice to the Company. Such notice shall specify the date on which this Agreement is to be terminated (the "Termination Date").

ops.oldText: (a) In the event the Company terminates this Agreement, the Company shall pay to HDI a termination payment, (the "Termination Payment") the amount of which shall be an amount equal to the aggregate Net Sales for the twelve (12) months preceding the Termination Date less $800,000, the balance of which shall be divided by two.
ops.newText: (a) No termination payment, early termination fee or other penalty shall be payable by the Company in connection with any termination of this Agreement.
